zh: 把配色下的强调色选项改成颜色卡：两张品牌卡画出各自的强调色、明暗背景与行内代码色，第三张自定义卡可以改这四个颜色，改一个就整页换上；圆点悬停时说明它是什么颜色，「图片颜色」多了强调色一档，此前存下的强调色成为自定义卡的第一个颜色。
en: Replace the accent option under Colours with colour cards: the two brand cards draw their accent, light and dark backgrounds and inline-code colour, and the third card lets the reader change those four, repainting the page as soon as one changes; each disc names its colour on hover, the image-colour choice gains an accent option, and a stored accent becomes the first colour of the reader's card.
